sections.title: Scenario events
sections.note: Meet her at this place and time to start the scene; talking costs 1 Heart Clock. Bond choices: +25 small, +50 medium, +100 big. Some days have different scenes depending on her Connection level. "Unlimited" scenes repeat after day 21.

rows.label: I find Emma on the walking trail.

rows.text: I hate missing out on my walk, but it's probably a good idea.
But I just got here...

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: I already ate, so I'll pass.
Sorry, but I'll have to decline. I have a stomachache.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: They're meant to be prepared for distinguished guests, so I can understand why they'd be difficult.
You'll get better with practice. Hang in there.

rows.label: I find Emma on the walking trail.

rows.text: Are you talking about Lumi?
Do you not remember her name?

rows.label: I find Emma at the waterfall.

rows.text: Personally, I find it a bit noisy.
It is a wonderful sound to focus on.

rows.label: I find Emma at the dormitory.

rows.text: Very much so.
It was, especially the dish that you made.

rows.label: I find Emma on the walking trail.

rows.text: I'm really excited.
Oh shoot, I almost forgot.

rows.label: I find Emma at the hot spring.

rows.text: I should hurry and try it out for myself.
How about we go in together next time?

rows.label: I find Emma at the hot spring.

rows.text: That's right.
No.

rows.label: I find Emma at the dormitory.

rows.text: ... It's a tough decision.
... Sure.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: Go for the dried bananas.
I can't recommend either of them.

rows.label: I find Emma at the waterfall.

rows.text: Doesn't staring at them get boring after a while?
I like to zone out like that once in a while, too.

rows.label: I find Emma on the walking trail.

rows.text: Yes. You're being too greedy.
No, I'd also like to go with you.

rows.label: I find Emma on the walking trail.

rows.text: I'm sure it's just a prank. Don't worry too much.
I'm worried too. Let's look for her together.

rows.label: I find Emma at the dormitory.

rows.text: You don't seem scared at all.
There's no need to be afraid. I'll protect you.

rows.label: I find Emma at the hot spring.

rows.text: I couldn't get any sleep either. I'm exhausted.
Are you feeling better now?

rows.label: I find Emma at the waterfall.

rows.text: Lean up next to her.
Wake her up.

rows.label: I find Emma in the bamboo forest.

rows.text: Maybe it's something like everyone taking a bath together?
I'd wager it has something to do with testing our luck.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: Maybe she took some pointers from certain master, like you.
Maybe she's been practicing.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: What about a cake, which is your specialty?
How about something like a hearty stew with a savory broth?

rows.label: I find Emma in the bamboo forest.

rows.text: Sounds like a lot of work.
I admire your work ethic.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: Hand her your empty plate.
Help her with the dishes.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: I feel the same way.
That sadness will diminish come tomorrow.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: You don't have to do that. Let's eat together.
I'd like to eat together with you today.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: That's why I want to get to know her more.
That's why I sometimes get scared around her.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: The soup?
Is that the soup we made the night we saw the rainbow at the waterfall?

rows.label: I find Emma at the hot spring.

rows.text: Did you use a new shampoo? Smells nice.
Did you use a new body wash? The smell is... a bit potent.

rows.label: I find Emma at the waterfall.

rows.text: Then we'll have to cherish it in our memories.
How about a video?

rows.label: I find Emma at the waterfall.

rows.text: You might be right.
I think all those fish got swept down the current.

rows.label: I find Emma at the hot spring.

rows.text: Can't say... I'm not really into bath salts.
I'll go with whatever you recommend.

rows.label: I find Emma at the hot spring.

rows.text: It's wonderful...
It looks delicious.

rows.label: I find Emma at the dormitory.

rows.text: That doesn't sound like packing to me...
Do you need help?

rows.label: I find Emma at the dormitory.

rows.text: You came looking for me just to give me this? Thank you.
You didn't have to go out of your way. Thank you.

rows.label: I find Emma at the waterfall.

rows.text: Well, it's too late to do anything about it now.
I've had similar thoughts, and feel a sense of regret.

rows.label: I find Emma at the waterfall.

rows.text: It almost feels like fate.
We do make a good match, don't we?

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: I also came for a final look at the restaurant.
I had a feeling you would be here, so I came to see you.

rows.label: I find Emma at the hot spring.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I came for a nice soak in the water.

rows.label: I find Emma at the dormitory.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I had something I needed to take care of.

rows.label: I find Emma at the restaurant.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
Just came to grab a quick meal.

sections.title: Emma's mood by level
sections.note: The diary line shown at each Connection level.
items: She seems more interested in the legend of Snowfield Hot Spring now.
She seems set on bringing the salad to the waterfall.
She is thinking about how to cook the fish while worrying about me.
She feels that Lumi seems to know a lot about this legend.
She seems to be considering how to grow closer to Lumi.
She silently thanks Lumi for bringing her closer to the waterfall's secret.
She seems happier because of the rainbow the three of us saw together.
She will never forget spending time with me at the waterfall.
